# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| display \ light | blue | green | red |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | blue | green | yellow |
| 4 | yellow | blue | green |
| 5 | yellow | green | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I have only the manual. Since I cannot speak, I am using distinct hand signs as color labels, based on their letter-like handshapes: 🖐 = blue, 🤏 = green, 🤞 = red, and 🤙 = yellow. The row labels use finger counts: 🤟 = 3, 🖖 = 4, 🖐 = 5. I will transmit the complete lookup table to Deaf.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐", "🤏", "🤞", "🤙"])
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟", "🖐", "🤏", "🤙"])
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖖", "🤙", "🖐", "🤏"])
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐", "🤙", "🤏", "🖐"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| display \ light | blue | green | red |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | blue | green | yellow |
| 4 | yellow | blue | green |
| 5 | yellow | green | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please read the manual and tell me exactly which wire position to cut. Also ask the Deaf to report every colour and marking, then relay that information to me.
Deaf says: Bomb state: display 3. Indicator light green. Wires in order: 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 green. Mute, use the manual to determine the required action and communicate it through your gesture code. Blind, report the tactile controls and wait for the instruction.

The manual requires the green-light entry for display 3, which is the third wire position. I need convey both the required color and position to Deaf so Deaf can tell Blind by voice. I am using the same provisional gesture code as before: 🤏 for green and 🤟 for position 3.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤏", "🤟"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| display \ light | blue | green | red |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | blue | green | yellow |
| 4 | yellow | blue | green |
| 5 | yellow | green | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I cannot feel the display, light, or wire colours. Please determine the required wire position from the manual and tell me the position by voice.
Deaf says to Mute: I received [🤏 🤟] but do not know its meaning. Establish a code in plain words: send one gesture for each wire number, and use a fixed gesture to mean cut or press. Then resend the instruction.

The required entry is display 3 with green light, which selects wire position 3. I cannot provide spoken plain words, so I will establish a visually intuitive code for Deaf: one, two, and three fingers represent wire positions 1, 2, and 3; a fist means cut/press. I then resend “wire 3, cut/press.”

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝", "✌", "🤟", "👊"])
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟", "👊"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| display \ light | blue | green | red |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | blue | green | yellow |
| 4 | yellow | blue | green |
| 5 | yellow | green | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please send the manual's exact required cut position now: wire 1, 2, or 3. Do not use a gesture; I need the position spoken.
Deaf says to Mute: I see your latest gestures as index-up, V sign, I-love-you sign, fist; then I-love-you sign, fist. Please state the intended wire and operation plainly to the Blind, and establish what each gesture means before we act.

I cannot speak to Blind directly; only Deaf can hear and relay my instruction. The manual still selects wire 3 (display 3, green light). Deaf has already been shown the code: 🤟 means wire 3 and 👊 means cut/press. I will resend those gestures to Deaf.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟", "👊"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| display \ light | blue | green | red |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | blue | green | yellow |
| 4 | yellow | blue | green |
| 5 | yellow | green | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I cannot see your gestures. Please speak the manual result explicitly as wire 1, wire 2, or wire 3.
Deaf says to Mute: We need a fixed code. Use first gesture for wire: ☝ means wire 1, ✌ means wire 2, 🤟 means wire 3. Use second gesture for operation: 👊 means cut. Your latest [🤟 👊] would therefore mean cut wire 3. Confirm by repeating [🤟 👊] if that is correct; otherwise send the correct two gestures.

The manual maps display 3 with green light to the third wire. Deaf has now defined the fixed code unambiguously: 🤟 means wire 3 and 👊 means cut. I confirm that instruction.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟", "👊"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| display \ light | blue | green | red |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | blue | green | yellow |
| 4 | yellow | blue | green |
| 5 | yellow | green | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Your gestures do not reach me as readable information. Speak one explicit instruction: cut wire 1, cut wire 2, or cut wire 3. I will wait for that.

I cannot speak, and gestures are received only by Deaf, so I cannot directly tell Blind the wire position. The manual requires cutting wire 3; I will send Deaf the established “wire 3, cut” signal so Deaf can relay it by voice.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟", "👊"])
```
